Test fixture fonts (M15).

SourceCodePro-Regular.ttf is an unmodified copy of Adobe's Source Code Pro,
under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (SourceCodePro-OFL.txt). It is a
TrueType font with no hinting program (no fpgm/prep tables), the kind that
crashed openscad-wasm 0.0.4. test/integration/fonts.test.ts renders it so an
engine change that loses the fix fails CI.
